title: Record page v3: a related list's title cannot be translated, so a self-lookup list on a contract page reads 「合同」 in zh-CN
body:
repo:hotclm#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jUw8KJgAwuwk6sqYLD

Filing gate: ① user-visible defect, reproduced in the browser on @objectstack 18.3.0 (hotclm 18.3 upgrade pass; hotclm decision-box batch 11, maintainer 「同意」 2026-11-03T16:16:59Z, ruled that hotclm follows the v3 record page and files its regressions here).

**Symptom.** hotclm's `clm_contract.renewed_from` is a lookup back to `clm_contract`. Since 18.3 retired `page.slots.tabs` (ADR-0085, #27053) the contract page draws that relationship as a side card, and the card's title is the child object's label: on a zh-CN console a contract page carries a card titled **「合同 0」** ("Contract") beside the contract itself. Before 18.3 the page's own `record:related_list` titled it 「续签合同」 through the bundle key `pages.contract_detail.components.contract_renewals.title`.

**Why the app cannot fix it.** The derived list's only title key is `field.relatedListTitle` (`packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts`), a plain `z.string()`; `translation.zod.ts` has no `objects.<child>.fields.<field>.relatedListTitle` slot (its sibling `inlineTitle` got one, #26142). Writing `relatedListTitle: 'Renewals'` would ship English to every zh-CN reader, and the i18n gate could not see it. A body-table field group's `label` (`fieldGroups[].relatedList`, #27069) is translatable but is not drawn as the table's title either (measured: the group labelled "Versions" draws a table titled with the child label 「合同版本」).

**Minimal repro.** Any object with a lookup to itself (or two lookups from one child): open a record whose locale is zh-CN — the side card reads the child object label.

**Expected capability.** A translatable title for a derived related list: either a `fields.<field>.relatedListTitle` bundle slot (the `inlineTitle` precedent), or the placing field group's translated `label` used as the title.

Evidence: /mnt/project-files/hotclm-objectstack-18-3-upgrade/02-detail-counsel-0.png (right column, 「合同 0」). Platform version: @objectstack/* 18.3.0.
